messages:
maria: Hey team — need a concise ops + legal playbook for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Focus: AMI/compute artifacts, IAM roles, KMS key access, billing/SKU mapping, trial config, and branding assets. Can we split owners and get a 30m sync this week?
ajit: I can take AMI + infra checklist. Will draft AMI naming + packaging rules.
rachel-legal: I will own contracts and trial T&Cs. Q: do we want a platform-wide trial (30 days) or per-customer trial flags?
ben-pm: Suggest 14-day trial for self-serve and 30-day for sales-assisted. SKU mapping: need SKU -> plan tier -> trial entitlements mapping doc. I'll own that.
nashley-marketing: I'll collect hero images, logos, and short product blurb. Need logo sizes: 1024x1024 for publisher portal, hero: 1600x600. Will upload to shared bucket.
simon-ops: Heads up on cross-account KMS: we need explicit key policies and a service account in partner account for provisioning AMIs. Also want to validate our trust relationship with publisher IAM role.
ajit: putting an example AMI tag/naming conv here:
```
redwood-inference-ami-<cloud>-<region>-<model>-v<semver>-<buildid>
Example: redwood-inference-ami-aws-us-west-2-gptalpha-v1.2.0-b1234
```
ajit: Also will add a small checklist for image hardening, PII scrub, and license attribution.
rachel-legal: We'll need to confirm included third-party licenses for bundled models and include EULA clause. Also: encryption-at-rest assurance for customer data in AMI.
ben-pm: For billing: mapping table example (SKU, meter, visible name, trial_length). I'll make a CSV template.
ashley-marketing: Draft hero copy: "Production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and cost. Available via AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces." Thoughts?
maria: Good. Can owners drop one-line commitments and we pick a sync time? I propose Thurs 11:00 PT.
ajit: I can deliver draft AMI + IAM doc by Wed EOD.
rachel-legal: Contract redlines by Thu morning.
ben-pm: SKU CSV + trial mapping by Wed.
ashley-marketing: Assets uploaded to s3://redwood-marketplace-assets/marketplace-1808 by Wed noon. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/redwood-marketplace-assets/marketplace-1808
simon-ops: I'll validate KMS policies and produce a minimal trust policy snippet. Example trust policy:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/MarketplacePublisher"},
    "Action": "kms:Decrypt"
  }]
}
```
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PARTNERS-9123 (marketplace onboarding playbook) https://tickets.internal/redwood/PARTNERS-9123
maria: Perfect. Thurs 11:00 PT stands. Agenda: owners walk through deliverables, blocker triage, next steps. I'll create calendar invite and add notes to the ticket. :thumbsup:
ajit: +1
rachel-legal: +1
ben-pm: +1
ashley-marketing: will be there
simon-ops: will join and bring checklist.
maria: Thanks everyone — please drop any pre-reads in the ticket before the sync.
